description: This Dart file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application, which displays a home page with various sections such as header, hero card, data science progress, popular courses grid, and suggested lessons. It manages state, fetches lesson data, and constructs a scrollable UI with animated components and navigation.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main stateful widget that displays the home screen for the app, including various sections such as header, hero, categories, and lesson lists.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the data fetching and build logic for HomeScreen.

classes.name: _HeaderRow
classes.description: A widget representing the header row with title and icon buttons.

classes.name: _HeaderRowState
classes.description: State class for _HeaderRow, managing icon button pressed states.

classes.name: _CircleIconButton
classes.description: A stateless widget for a circular icon button with animated press effects.

classes.name: _CoursesGrid
classes.description: Displays a grid of course category cards.

classes.name: _AnimatedAppear
classes.description: Animated widget that fades and moves in its child after an optional delay.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontal
classes.description: A widget representing a horizontally scrolling lesson card with progress indication.

classes.name: _LessonCardHorizontalState
classes.description: State class managing the press animation for _LessonCardHorizontal.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers data loading.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Asynchronous method to fetch lessons from repository and update state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including layout and conditional loading.
